say: Why does rock sound so heavy?
show: Why does rock sound so heavy? *Guitarists delete one note.*

say: The middle note is the third.
show: The middle note, the *third*, decides happy or sad.

say: Only E and B are left.
show: Delete it: only *E and B*. Root and fifth.

say: With distortion, a third turns harsh and muddy.
A fifth stays clean and powerful.
show: With distortion, a third turns *muddy*. A fifth stays *clean*.

say: On guitar, it is two fingers.
The root on the low string.
The fifth, two frets up, on the next string.
show: On guitar: root on the low string, *fifth two frets up* on the next.

say: That is why one shape can play a thousand rock riffs.
show: That's why one shape plays *a thousand rock riffs*.
